name: fld_finite_field_sum_two_squares
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (a : K) : ∃ x y : K, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = a
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (a : K), ∃ x y : K, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = a
informal: Every element of a finite field is a sum of two squares — in characteristic 2 every element is a square (FiniteField.isSquare_of_char_two); otherwise apply FiniteField.exists_root_sum_quadratic to X^2 and X^2 - a (card is odd), or pigeonhole on the (q+1)/2 squares.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [Fintype K] (a : K), ∃ x y, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = a
